title: Sydney Sweeney Shares PDA-Filled Montage of Romantic Moments With Scooter Braun
summary: The couple first sparked dating rumors after attending Jeff Bezos' wedding last June.
contentText:
It looks like Sydney Sweeney and Scooter Braun are enjoying a euphoric romance together, with the actress sharing a loved-up montage of some of her sweetest moments with the music mogul Wednesday (May 13) on her Instagram Story .

Related

Ariana Grande Shares a ‘Piece’ of How She Healed Her ‘Broken’ Relationship to Music: ‘I Have a New Team Now’

Scooter Braun Reveals Where He Stands With Former Client Ye Following Rapper’s Antisemitism

Scooter Braun Calls Taylor Swift the ‘Biggest Artist of All Time,’ Addresses Whether ‘Vigilante S–t’ Is About Him

In the clips largely filmed by Sweeney, the couple packs on the PDA, with Braun showering her with kisses on the cheek on the beach and holding hands as they embark on a helicopter ride over the ocean. At one point, they suit up in scuba gear to go for a deep-sea dive, with the video ending on the pair slow dancing in a living room and kissing.

The Euphoria star soundtracked the montage with feel-good track “Who You Share It With” by Layup. “Times and places are all in who you share em with/ It’s life, and the point is enjoyin’ who you share it with,” singer Chris Henderson croons over the romantic clips of Sweeney and Braun. “Joy is who you share it with.”

Billboard has reached out to Braun and Sweeney’s reps for comment.

The Housemaid actress and SB Projects founder first sparked dating rumors after they both attended Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez’s wedding in Italy in June 2025. A few months prior to that, reports emerged that Sweeney had broken things off with her longtime partner and then-fiancé, producer Jonathan Davino. Braun was previously married to Yael Cohen, with whom he shares three children; he filed for divorce in 2021, seven years after they tied the knot.

Nearly one year after crossing paths in Italy at the Amazon billionaire’s nuptials, Sweeney and Braun have been sharing more about their relationship with the public in recent weeks. In late April, the couple attended Stagecoach, where the Hollywood star hosted a pop-up for her lingerie brand, Syrn. Afterward, she shared an Instagram carousel of photos and videos of herself and the former music manager enjoying the festival, including a snap of her watching a set from atop his shoulders and a clip of them joyously singing karaoke while sharing a mic.
